actions.text: Find comparable sales for an Upper West Side co-op

List the 20 recent sales in data/sales.csv most comparable to a 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom co-op on the Upper West Side: about 1,100 sq ft, maintenance about $2,400 a month, in a prewar elevator building. Only Upper West Side co-ops sold in the last 24 months count; rank them by how close they are in size, bedrooms, bathrooms, monthly charges, building and sale date.
A report of exactly 20 sales, ranked, each with address and unit, sale price, price per square foot, sale date, score and one line on why it ranks there, plus the same table as a CSV.
Read-only: change nothing in the repository, its data or the website.
